Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray of the 12-year-old patient (Figure 1) demonstrates marked reticulonodular interstitial markings and cystic changes predominantly in the upper lobes, which are significantly more prominent than the relatively clear lung fields seen in the 3-year-old patient (Figure 4). This indicates a progression of subpleural lung cysts and interstitial disease with age in Down syndrome-associated pulmonary fibrosis.
